equivalent_not_counted.rule: i + value_length > len makes the whole matchlet FALSE, not continue
equivalent_not_counted.why: the bound is monotone in i: every later i also fails it, so 'False' and 'continue' give the same answer for every finite data; no case can separate them without a 32-bit i wrap
the Python model has no 32-bit wrap; the C case is undefined behaviour (the oracle reads out of bounds), so it is outside the declared surface and no oracle-labelled case can exist

equivalent_not_counted.rule: the swap block runs only when word_size > 1
equivalent_not_counted.why: a size-1 swap is a byte-wise no-op and size 0 cannot reach the block; '>1', '>0' and '!=1' agree for every accepted size, and '!=0' would divide by zero on size 0

equivalent_not_counted.rule: a parse error skips to the next newline
equivalent_not_counted.why: skipping one byte instead still ends at the same newline: every following byte that is not '[' re-enters the error state and the skip continues; measured identical on the probe set

equivalent_not_counted.rule: a parse error at EOF ends the file

equivalent_not_counted.rule: a section with no matchlets is inserted but can never hold
